lead: App-wide configuration: placed once at the app root, it writes the theme style, mode and color theme to `<html>` (overlays render in a Portal, so the attributes must be there), and gives date components and components with text a default locale and labels. It only changes attributes, never the structure, so the subtree is not remounted.

root.title: App root
root.note: This site's theme style, mode and color theme are set by the switches at the top right, so this example doesn't add another layer that would fight them.

locale.title: Locale and labels
locale.description: Every Calendar, Pagination and Carousel inside takes the locale and labels from the provider; a component's own `locale` / `labels` still win. Here: German.

api.title: API Reference
api.useConfig: `useConfig()` returns `{ locale?, labels? }`: use it when your own components should read the same configuration.
